turnPhases.summary: Set all rested cards active, then draw 1 card.
Place 1 Resource from Resource Deck into Resource Area (up to 10; Going 2nd starts with 1 EX Resource).
Deploy Units/Bases, pair Pilots onto Units (triggering Link if matched), play Main Commands, and declare Attacks.
Defending player may activate <Blocker> or Action Commands during combat windows.
Resolve end-of-turn triggers such as <Repair X> and discard down to hand limit if applicable.

generalFaqs.q: Is there a restriction to the number of cards in a deck?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, there is. A deck must be constructed with exactly 50 cards.

generalFaqs.q: Are there any requirements to consider when constructing a deck?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, there are. A deck must be constructed entirely using either one or two card colors. Four card types can be included in a deck: Unit, Pilot, Command, and Base.

generalFaqs.q: How many copies of a card with the same card number can be included in a deck?
generalFaqs.a: Up to four copies of a card with the same card number can be included.

generalFaqs.q: Can I include four copies of the ST01-001 Gundam card as well as four copies of the GD01-013 Gundam card in my deck?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, you can. As long as their card numbers are different, you can include four copies of each different card in your deck, even if their card names are the same.

generalFaqs.q: Is there a restriction to the number of cards in a resource deck?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, there is. A resource deck must be constructed with exactly ten cards.

generalFaqs.q: Are there any requirements to consider when constructing a resource deck?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, there are. A resource deck must be constructed using only cards of the Resource card type. Any number of copies of Resource cards with the same card number may be included.

generalFaqs.q: Where do I place tokens that I've brought for use with my deck?
generalFaqs.a: Place them together someplace outside of the playing area.

generalFaqs.q: Do cards placed into the shield section of the shield area have a particular order?
generalFaqs.a: Yes. Place them so that the top card from your deck becomes the bottom Shield.

generalFaqs.q: When and how are Player One and Player Two determined?
generalFaqs.a: Play a game of rock paper scissors or use a similar method. The winner then chooses who goes first before looking at their starting hand.

generalFaqs.q: Can I redraw my starting hand?
generalFaqs.a: Yes. Each player can redraw their starting hand once, starting with Player One. If you choose to redraw your hand, return your entire original hand to the bottom of your deck and draw five new cards from the top of your deck to create a new starting hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

generalFaqs.q: What is an EX Base?
generalFaqs.a: An EX Base is a Base token with 0 AP and 3 HP that both players place in the base section of their shield areas at the start of the game.

generalFaqs.q: What is an EX Resource?
generalFaqs.a: An EX Resource is a Resource token that Player Two places in their resource area at the start of the game. Some effects also place EX Resources during the game.

generalFaqs.q: Can I leave a card rested during my start phase rather than setting it as active?
generalFaqs.a: No, you cannot.

generalFaqs.q: Can I choose not to draw a card during my draw phase?
generalFaqs.a: No, you cannot.

generalFaqs.q: Can Player One draw a card during the draw phase of their first turn?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, they can.

generalFaqs.q: Is there a maximum number of cards that can be in a hand?
generalFaqs.a: No, there is not. However, if you have 11 or more cards in your hand during your end phase, you must discard down to 10 cards.

generalFaqs.q: As a result of drawing a card from my deck, it now has no cards in it. At this time, what happens to the game?
generalFaqs.a: The moment a deck has no cards in it, that player loses the game.

generalFaqs.q: Can I choose not to place a Resource during my resource phase?
generalFaqs.a: No, you cannot.

generalFaqs.q: Is there a maximum number of cards that can be in the resource area?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, there is. Up to 10 Resource cards from the resource deck and 5 EX Resource cards can be placed into the resource area, for a total of 15 cards.

generalFaqs.q: If a resource deck has no cards in it, does the resource phase occur?
generalFaqs.a: It does occur, and then that turn immediately advances to the main phase since there are no cards.

generalFaqs.q: When determining my Lv. while playing a card, do I include EX Resources in my resource area?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, you do. If you have two Resources and one EX Resource, you can play any card that is Lv.3 or less.

generalFaqs.q: When playing a card, I paid its cost with an EX Resource, so that EX Resource was removed from the game. Afterwards, what happens to the Lv. of cards I can play?
generalFaqs.a: Since the EX Resource was removed from the game and the number of Resources has decreased, the Lv. of cards you can play decreases by the same amount.

generalFaqs.q: How do I play a Command card with a Pilot effect as a Pilot?
generalFaqs.a: After paying the card's cost as you normally would to play it, pair it with a Unit as a Pilot instead of activating its Command effect.

generalFaqs.q: Can I deploy a Unit if there is already a Unit with the same card name deployed in my battle area?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, you can.

generalFaqs.q: Can I pair a Pilot with a Unit if there is already a Pilot with the same card name paired with another Unit in my battle area?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, you can.

generalFaqs.q: Is there a maximum number of Units that can be deployed into the battle area?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, there is. Up to six Units can be deployed into the battle area.

generalFaqs.q: When there are already six Units deployed, can I deploy a new Unit?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, you can. If you want to deploy a new Unit when the battle area is full, place one previously deployed Unit into the trash, then deploy the new Unit. The Unit placed into the trash at this time is not treated as being destroyed.

generalFaqs.q: Is there a maximum number of Bases that can be deployed into the base section of the shield area?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, there is. Up to one Base can be deployed into the base section of the shield area.

generalFaqs.q: When a Base is already deployed, can I deploy a new Base?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, you can. Place the previously deployed Base into the trash, then deploy the new Base. The Base placed into the trash at this time is not treated as being destroyed.

generalFaqs.q: Can I activate the 【Activate･Main】 effect on a Unit during the same turn it was deployed?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, you can.

generalFaqs.q: Can Player One attack during their first turn?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, they can. However, Units cannot immediately attack during the turn in which they are deployed.

generalFaqs.q: What happens when an attack on a player occurs?
generalFaqs.a: When a player is attacked, check if there are cards in their shield area. If a Base is present, the Base is attacked. Otherwise, the first Shield is attacked. If no cards are in the shield area, the opposing player themselves is attacked directly.

generalFaqs.q: If the attacking Unit or the Unit being targeted moves to another location, what happens to that attack?
generalFaqs.a: Advance to the battle end step, skipping all steps in between.

generalFaqs.q: Can a Unit with 0 AP attack?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, it can.

generalFaqs.q: Can an attack from a Unit with 0 AP destroy an opponent's Shield?
generalFaqs.a: No, it cannot. Each Shield is treated as having 1 HP.

generalFaqs.q: Can I choose which Shield is destroyed?
generalFaqs.a: No, you cannot. If multiple Shields are present, destroy the first Shield.

generalFaqs.q: Can I destroy a Shield instead of destroying a Base?
generalFaqs.a: No, you cannot.

generalFaqs.q: If a Command card with 【Action】 timing has a Pilot effect, can I pair it as a Pilot during an action step?
generalFaqs.a: No, you cannot.

generalFaqs.q: When a battle between two Units occurs, how is damage dealt between them?
generalFaqs.a: Each Unit deals damage equal to its AP to the other unit simultaneously. If the attacking Unit has <First Strike>, that Unit deals damage first. If the other Unit is destroyed as a result, the attacking Unit does not receive damage.

generalFaqs.q: When a Shield is destroyed, what happens to it?
generalFaqs.a: The destroyed Shield is revealed and placed into the trash. If it has a 【Burst】 effect, choose whether or not to activate that 【Burst】 effect before it is placed into the trash.

generalFaqs.q: If a Unit paired with a Pilot is destroyed or otherwise moves to another location such as due to an effect, what happens to the paired Pilot?
generalFaqs.a: It moves to the same location as the Unit. Move it to the trash if the Unit is destroyed, or to your hand with the Unit if the Unit is returned to your hand.

generalFaqs.q: What does "play" mean?
generalFaqs.a: This describes paying the cost of a card in your hand and using it.

generalFaqs.q: What does "deploy" mean?
generalFaqs.a: This describes when a Unit enters the battle area or a Base enters the base section of the shield area.

generalFaqs.q: What does "draw 1" mean?
generalFaqs.a: This describes adding the top card of your deck to your hand.

generalFaqs.q: What does "discard 1" mean?
generalFaqs.a: This describes choosing one card in your hand and placing it into your trash.

generalFaqs.q: What does "recover" mean?
generalFaqs.a: This describes removing damage from a damaged card. If an effect says "recover 2 HP," remove 2 damage.

generalFaqs.q: What does "pair" mean?
generalFaqs.a: This describes placing a Pilot card or a Command card with a Pilot effect beneath a Unit.

generalFaqs.q: What is a "Link Unit"?
generalFaqs.a: Some Units have link requirements, such as Pilot names or traits, listed on them. A Unit paired with a Pilot that satisfies its link requirements is called a Link Unit. Link Units can attack immediately on the turn they are deployed.

generalFaqs.q: What is a "token"?
generalFaqs.a: A token is anything placed into play from outside the game by an effect. EX Bases and EX Resources placed at the start of the game are also tokens.

generalFaqs.q: Some effects use "/" characters to list multiple items in a row, such as traits. For example, "1 (Zeon)/(Neo Zeon) Unit card." What does this mean?
generalFaqs.a: The "/" character represents the conjunction "or." If an effect reads "1 (Zeon)/(Neo Zeon) Unit card," you can choose either one (Zeon) Unit card or one (Neo Zeon) Unit card.

generalFaqs.q: If a Unit is undamaged when I reach the end of my turn, does <Repair> activate?
generalFaqs.a: No, it does not.

generalFaqs.q: If a Unit with <Repair 2> gains a new copy of <Repair 1>, what happens to <Repair> on that Unit?
generalFaqs.a: If a Unit with <Repair> gains a new copy of <Repair>, add up each of the individual <Repair> amounts. In this situation, the Unit would be treated as having <Repair 3>.

generalFaqs.q: What does "deal the specified amount of damage to a card in that opponent's shield area" mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means check the shield area, and if a Base is present, deal damage to it. Otherwise, deal damage to the first Shield.

generalFaqs.q: If there are no cards in the opponent's shield area, does <Breach> activate?
generalFaqs.a: No, it does not.

generalFaqs.q: If a Unit with <Breach> attacks and both Units are destroyed in the battle, does <Breach> activate?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, it does.

generalFaqs.q: A Unit with <Breach> destroys an enemy Unit with a 【Destroyed】 effect using battle damage. At this time, which effect is resolved first, <Breach> or the 【Destroyed】 effect?
generalFaqs.a: Resolve <Breach> first. Since the "When this Unit's attack destroys an enemy Unit" portion of <Breach> and the 【Destroyed】 effect resolve simultaneously, resolve the active player's <Breach> effect first.

generalFaqs.q: If a Unit with <Breach 2> gains a new copy of <Breach 1>, what happens to <Breach> on that Unit?
generalFaqs.a: If a Unit with <Breach> gains a new copy of <Breach>, add up each of the individual <Breach> amounts. In this situation, the Unit would be treated as having <Breach 3>.

generalFaqs.q: If a Unit with <Support 2> gains a new copy of <Support 1>, what happens to <Support> on that Unit?
generalFaqs.a: If a Unit with <Support> gains a new copy of <Support>, add up each of the individual <Support> amounts. In this situation, the Unit would be treated as having <Support 3>.

generalFaqs.q: Can <Blocker> on a rested Unit be activated?
generalFaqs.a: No, it cannot.

generalFaqs.q: Can one Unit have multiple copies of <Blocker>?
generalFaqs.a: No, it cannot.

generalFaqs.q: What does "it deals damage before the enemy Unit" mean?
generalFaqs.a: Normally during the damage step, battling Units deal battle damage to each other simultaneously. However, a Unit with <First Strike> deals its battle damage to the enemy Unit first.

generalFaqs.q: As a result of dealing damage first with <First Strike> during the damage step, the enemy Unit is destroyed. At this time, is damage received from the battling enemy Unit?
generalFaqs.a: No, it is not.

generalFaqs.q: Can one Unit have multiple copies of <First Strike>?
generalFaqs.a: No, it cannot.

generalFaqs.q: Can one Unit have multiple copies of <High-Maneuver>?
generalFaqs.a: No, it cannot.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【Deploy】 mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means that effect activates when the card with 【Deploy】 is deployed.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【Attack】 mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means that effect activates when the card with 【Attack】 declares an attack.

generalFaqs.q: When is an effect with 【Attack】 timing resolved?
generalFaqs.a: Resolve it after the Unit with 【Attack】 declares its attack.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【Destroy】 mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means that effect activates when the card with 【Destroy】 is destroyed and placed into the trash.

generalFaqs.q: Where does the 【Destroy】 effect activate?
generalFaqs.a: It activates in the trash as an effect on that card. When determining the state of the card with 【Destroy】, refer to that card's state while it was still in the battle area or shield area, immediately before it was placed into the trash.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【Activate･Main】 mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means that effect can be activated during your main phase by fulfilling any conditions listed before the "：" character.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【Activate･Action】 mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means that effect can be activated during your action steps or your opponent's action steps by fulfilling any conditions listed before the "：" character.

generalFaqs.q: What does "【Activate･Main】①：" mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means that paying the numerical cost printed within the circle is a condition for activating that effect.

generalFaqs.q: If an 【Activate･Main】 or 【Activate･Action】 effect has no activation conditions listed, how do I activate it?
generalFaqs.a: Activate it by declaring you are doing so.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【When Paired】 mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means the effect activates when a Pilot is paired with the Unit with 【When Paired】.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【When Paired･(Zeon) Pilot】 mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means the effect only activates when a Pilot with the (Zeon) trait is paired with that Unit. If a 【When Paired】 effect appears as 【When Paired･(qualifications) Pilot】, like in this example, a Pilot satisfying those (qualifications) must be paired with the Unit in order to activate that effect.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【During Pair】 mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means the effect listed after the 【During Pair】 timing is active while the Unit with 【During Pair】 is paired with a Pilot.

generalFaqs.q: Sometimes the 【During Pair】 timing is immediately followed by 【Attack】. What does this mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means the effect activates when the Unit is paired with a Pilot and it attacks. If a Pilot is not paired with the Unit, the 【Attack】 effect will not activate.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【Once per Turn】 mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means the effect including 【Once per Turn】 will not activate more than one time during the same turn.

generalFaqs.q: If multiple copies of a card with the same card number and a 【Once per Turn】 effect are in play, can each of those copies activate that effect during the same turn?
generalFaqs.a: Yes. Each of them can activate that effect one time.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【Burst】 mean?
generalFaqs.a: If a Shield is destroyed and the revealed Shield card has a 【Burst】 effect, it means that effect can be activated before the card is placed into the trash.

generalFaqs.q: Can I choose not to activate a 【Burst】 effect?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, you can. The card is placed into the trash without being activated.

generalFaqs.q: After a 【Burst】 effect on a card is activated, what happens to that card?
generalFaqs.a: Unless specified otherwise, the card is placed into the trash.

generalFaqs.q: When a card added to my hand with the effect "Add 1 of your Shields to your hand" has a 【Burst】 effect, can I activate it?
generalFaqs.a: No, you cannot.

generalFaqs.q: Is there a difference between "1 of your Units" and "1 friendly Unit"?
generalFaqs.a: There is no difference when playing with 1v1 rules. "1 friendly Unit" means you can choose a teammate's Unit when playing with team battle rules, such as 2v2.

generalFaqs.q: Can a Pilot be placed in the battle area by itself?
generalFaqs.a: No, it cannot.

generalFaqs.q: Can I swap in a new Pilot on a Unit that is already paired with a Pilot?
generalFaqs.a: No, you cannot.

generalFaqs.q: Can I take a Pilot already paired with a Unit and pair it with another Unit?
generalFaqs.a: No, you cannot.

generalFaqs.q: An effect on a Pilot paired with a Unit gets resolved as though it belongs to which card?
generalFaqs.a: Resolve it as though it belongs to the Unit.

generalFaqs.q: I paired ST03-011 Char Aznable with a Unit with the link requirement [Amuro Ray]. At this time, are AP and HP added to the Unit and can the 【Attack】 effect activate?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, AP and HP are added and the 【Attack】 effect can activate. If fulfilled, link requirements enable the Unit to attack immediately on the turn it is deployed. They do not prevent the addition of values and activation of effects when they are not fulfilled.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【Main】 on a Command card mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means that card can be played from your hand during your main phase.

generalFaqs.q: What does 【Action】 on a Command card mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means that card can be played from your hand during your action steps or your opponent's action steps.

generalFaqs.q: If a Command card has 【Main】/【Action】 printed on it, can it be played during either of those times?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, it can.

generalFaqs.q: Can a blue Unit paired with a green Pilot be treated as a green Unit?
generalFaqs.a: No, it cannot.

generalFaqs.q: What happens to a Unit whose AP becomes zero or less due to an effect?
generalFaqs.a: Treat it as a Unit with 0 AP rather than the actual value.

generalFaqs.q: A Unit with 1 AP receives the effect "it gets AP-2" then gets AP+3 from another effect after that. At this time, what is the Unit's AP value?
generalFaqs.a: It is the result of 1-2+3, or 2 AP.

generalFaqs.q: When an effect such as "choose 1 enemy Unit with 2 or less HP" references a card's HP, does it reference its current HP?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, it does. If the card is damaged, reference its HP after reducing it by that damage amount.

generalFaqs.q: What is "battle damage"?
generalFaqs.a: This is damage dealt by a card's AP, typically during battle.

generalFaqs.q: Does the damage mentioned in effects like "when a Unit is destroyed with damage" include battle damage?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, it does.

generalFaqs.q: Does damage received by a Unit disappear at the end of the turn?
generalFaqs.a: No, it does not. Damage remains on the Unit in the form of a damage counter.

generalFaqs.q: Can I activate an effect or play a card if doing so requires that a target be selected but there are no targets available?
generalFaqs.a: No, you cannot.

generalFaqs.q: Do tokens have a color?
generalFaqs.a: No. Tokens do not have a color.

generalFaqs.q: Lv. and cost are not shown on tokens. How are a token's Lv. and cost treated?
generalFaqs.a: Treat a token's Lv. and cost as both being zero.

generalFaqs.q: Can a Pilot be paired with a Unit token?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, it can.

generalFaqs.q: Are Unit tokens included in the maximum number of Units that can be deployed?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, they are.

generalFaqs.q: A new Unit is deployed after the effect "all your Units get AP+2 during this turn" has activated. At this time, does the newly deployed Unit also get AP+2?
generalFaqs.a: No, it does not. Effects that bestow some effect on all Units are only applied to Units that were in the battle area at that time.

generalFaqs.q: After an effect which specifies "during this turn" has been activated by an effect such as 【Activate･Main】, the Unit with that 【Activate･Main】 effect is destroyed. At this time, does the effect specifying "during this turn" remain in effect?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, it does.

generalFaqs.q: If two or more of my effects activate simultaneously, can I choose the order I resolve them in?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, you can.

generalFaqs.q: If multiple effects activate at the same time, how do players resolve them?
generalFaqs.a: The active player resolves all of their effects first. Then, the standby player resolves all of their effects.

generalFaqs.q: Multiple effects activate at the same time and a new effect activates while they are being resolved. At this time, how do players resolve the effects?
generalFaqs.a: Give the new effect priority and resolve it. If multiple new effects activate simultaneously, give them priority and resolve them, starting with the active player's effects.

generalFaqs.q: Multiple effects activate at the same time, and when resolving a <Breach> effect it destroys an enemy Shield that activates a 【Burst】 effect. At this time, how do players resolve the effects?
generalFaqs.a: Give the 【Burst】 effect priority and resolve it.

generalFaqs.q: While resolving multiple effects in order after they have activated, a Unit that activated an effect that has not yet been resolved is destroyed. At this time, how do players resolve the effects?
generalFaqs.a: An effect that has already activated and is waiting to be resolved is still resolved even if the Unit activating it leaves the field.

generalFaqs.q: If an effect negates another effect, or says it "can't" have an effect, how are those effects resolved?
generalFaqs.a: Give priority to the effect that negates the other effect or says it "can't" have an effect.

generalFaqs.q: When is a Command card like Peaceful Timbre (ST02-013) that has a 【Pilot】 effect treated as a Pilot?
generalFaqs.a: It is only treated as a Pilot while in the battle area paired with a Unit. It is a Command card in all other locations.

generalFaqs.q: When two Shields are destroyed by <Suppression> damage, are they revealed simultaneously?
generalFaqs.a: Yes, they are. If there are any 【Burst】 effects on those cards, resolve them.

generalFaqs.q: Two Shields are destroyed by <Suppression> damage and revealed, and they both have 【Burst】 effects. At this time, how should they be resolved?
generalFaqs.a: The owner of those Shields chooses what order to resolve the 【Burst】 effects in and resolves them one at a time.

generalFaqs.q: If there is only one Shield in the opponent's shield area, is <Suppression> damage also dealt to the player?
generalFaqs.a: No, it is not. Damage is only dealt to that one Shield.

generalFaqs.q: A Shield destroyed by <Suppression> damage is revealed to be a Base card with a 【Burst】 effect. At this time, if I add one of my Shields to my hand for the effect on the Base deployed by the 【Burst】 effect, can I add the second Shield that would be destroyed by <Suppression> to my hand?
generalFaqs.a:
No, you cannot.
The Shields destroyed by <Suppression> are destroyed simultaneously. The Shield you can add to your hand for the deployed Base is the first Shield in your shield area that was not destroyed.

generalFaqs.q: What does "reduce" mean?
generalFaqs.a: It means to decrease the damage received. For example, when 3 damage is received and you are told to "reduce it by 1," that damage becomes 2.

generalFaqs.q: When the effects "reduce damage it receives by 2" and "reduce damage it receives by 3" both activate on the same Unit, is the damage reduced by a total of five?
generalFaqs.a: Yes. Reduce the damage by five.

GD02-004.q: Does the Unit chosen by this effect get set as active by the 【Main】 effect on GD01-121 Midair Modifications after that card's 【Burst】 effect activates it?
GD02-004.a: Yes, it is set as active. During the specified turn's start phase is the only time when it won't be set as active. Setting it as active in a different phase with an effect is valid.

GD02-018.q: Does "This Unit can't choose the enemy player as its attack target" mean it can't attack the enemy Base or Shields either?

GD02-021.q: If I am Lv.7 or higher, can I draw a card with this effect without discarding one green (Earth Federation) Unit card?

GD02-037.q: Does "If there are 3 or less enemy Shields" also count the Base in the opponent's shield area?

GD02-038.q: When deploying a Unit with this 【Deploy】 effect, does that Unit's cost need to be paid?
If the Unit deployed by this 【Deploy】 effect has a 【Deploy】 effect, does it activate?
Can I choose not to activate this 【Deploy】 ability?
GD02-038.a: No. You are forced to activate this effect up to and including the portion "Look at the top 3 cards of your deck." Whether or not you deploy an eligible card among them is your choice.

GD02-071.q: When I pair a Pilot with this 【Deploy】 effect, do I have to pay that Pilot's cost?
Are 【When Paired】 and 【When Linked】 effects activated by a Pilot paired with this 【Deploy】 effect?

GD02-073.q: An enemy Unit attacks this Unit and gains <First Strike>. Then, I block with another Unit, so the enemy Unit is no longer battling this Unit. At this time, does that enemy Unit lose <First Strike>?

GD02-076.q: With the conditions for its effect fulfilled, this Unit gains <Blocker> and blocks an enemy Unit. After that, the conditions become unfulfilled and it loses <Blocker>. At this time, what happens to this Unit's block?
GD02-076.a: Since the block is already established, the two Units continue their battle.

GD02-082.q: With the conditions for its effect fulfilled, this Unit gains <Blocker> and blocks an enemy Unit. After that, the conditions become unfulfilled and it loses <Blocker>. At this time, what happens to this Unit's block?
GD02-082.a: Since the block is already established, the two Units continue their battle.

GD02-085.q: Does "when this Unit recovers HP" activate even when an undamaged Unit receives a recover HP effect?
GD02-085.a: No, it does not. An undamaged Unit cannot recover HP.
